name: Concord Parks & Recreation Traditional Summer Camps (Stay & Play, Rec Adventure, Adventure)
operator_name: Concord Parks & Recreation (City of Concord, NH)
description_short: City-run summer day camps for kids in grades 1-8, 8:30am to 4:30pm. Stay & Play (grades 1-5) is an 8-week camp at the City Wide Community Center and Keach Park with swimming, cooking, crafts and field games. The two Adventure camps for older kids take out-of-town trips Monday to Thursday and spend Fridays in town.
swim_waterfront_notes: Stay & Play includes swimming. Adventure camp trips include beach trips, kayaking and surfing. The page gives no details on supervision or swim testing.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests must be in writing. Cancel three weeks or more before camp starts for a full refund minus the $20 per camp deposit. Later cancellations get no refund without a doctor's note.
